digest.component_or_area: metrics adapters — GitHub Actions coverage and CI-health harvester
propositions: GitHub Actions run logs retain coverage % and CI-health metadata only within a short window; a new isolated adapter must harvest and persist these metrics as labeled snapshots to .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson so trends survive GHA retention limits.

The adapter parses coverage % from pytest-cov TOTAL line in run-log tail via word-boundary grep and computes CI-health metrics (status, duration, red→green recovery interval, recheck/flake rate) from run-metadata JSON.

scripts/harvest_gha.py pulls recent test.yml run logs and metadata via the gh Actions API, feeds them through the adapter, and writes snapshots to the git-tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson store (not reports/, which is gitignored).
The core metrics command and modules must not import the GHA adapter to preserve portability; the adapter is isolated and optional so a parallel adapter targeting another CI can coexist.

The CI workflow test.yml is not edited to commit snapshots because CI runs with read-only permissions and ephemeral checkouts; the harvester script runs locally/by maintainer and reads GHA API post-hoc instead.
